title: Premier Bernard Lord at re-enacting 1901 dinner
description: Premier Bernard Lord, accompanied by his wife, Diane Lord, their daughter Jasmine, and son Sebastin, is seated at the anniversary dinner at the United Baptist Church. Observing are Co-Chair John Glass and Deputy Premier Dale Graham.
